# 87th Drama League Awards

| venue =
}}
The 88th Drama League Awards were held on May 21, 2021, recognizing excellence in theatre productions during the 2020–21 season. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, five new categories were created for this year's ceremony only, reflecting the restrictions on live performance. Nominations were announced on March 31, 2021, and winners were announced on May 21, 2021, virtually.
Winners and nominees
The 2020-2021 Outer Critics Circle Awards nominations were announced on Monday, April 25, 2022, with the virtual winners announcement ceremony held on Friday, May 21, 2021. The five special categories for the year were:
*Outstanding Digital Theatre, Individual Production
*Outstanding Digital Theatre, Collection or Festival
*Outstanding Interactive or Socially-Distanced Theatre
*Outstanding Audio Theatre Production
*Outstanding Digital Concert Production
Special honorees included:
*The Actors Fund - Contribution to the Theatre Award
*Richard & Demi Weitz - Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theatre
*Liesl Tommy -  Founders Award for Excellence in Directing
* Iris Smith - Gratitude Award
